title: The withheld-credit line tells the holder to "run it again on its own" even when no criterion or obligation needs that check
outcome: When an ordinary check is withheld as overlapped, the holder's line says "Run it again on its own to record it" unconditionally. For a check nothing needs, such as a release installation build after an already credited full gate and accepted evaluation, that invites an unnecessary credit-only rerun, which the project's rules forbid. The line should distinguish a check that a bound criterion or open obligation still needs (rerun guidance stays) from optional credit (it states plainly that no rerun is needed).
acceptance: The withheld line advises a rerun only when an open obligation or an unsatisfied bound criterion of the holder's item could use that check kind; otherwise it says the check was not recorded and no rerun is needed. A test covers both cases.
The change shares the withheld line with w-4f5100c27046 (cause naming) without duplicating its implementation.
The full gate passes on the exact landed input.
